parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for each request. The **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters.

parameters.name: Commodity
parameters.description: The subscription period for the purchase order.

parameters.name: OperationName
parameters.description: The name of the upgrade or downgrade operation.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameters to deploy the service instance.

parameters.name: TrialType
parameters.description:
The usage type. Valid values:

- Trial: The service supports a free trial.

- NotTrial: The service does not support a free trial.
